items.title: Luxury sales plunge in China as tax push hits wealthy shoppers
items.summary: Bloomberg-sourced reporting (via FashionNetwork/ChinaRetailNews) finds sales at China's 25 biggest luxury labels fell more than 10% in July 2026 as a crackdown on offshore wealth taxation curbed spending; Kering's Gucci, Bottega Veneta and Balenciaga posted double-digit drops alongside LVMH's Louis Vuitton and Dior, with Hermes swinging from gains to losses.

items.title: Kering stock reacts to China luxury slowdown as investors weigh Gucci recovery
items.summary: Kering shares fell 3.6% after fresh data showed weaker China luxury demand, with markets treating Gucci's China trajectory as the key swing factor for group recovery even as consensus still expects a gradual sales rebound later in 2026.

items.source: 36Kr (EU edition) — "Why Don't Rich People Buy GUCCI Anymore?"
items.title: Why Don't Rich People Buy GUCCI Anymore?
items.summary: Chinese business-media analysis reports Gucci 2025 revenue fell 22% to EUR5.99bn and profit halved, ties the decline to serial creative-director turnover, absence of a hit bag since Dionysus, and outlet-driven discounting (eight China outlet stores at 50-75% off) that consumers say guts resale value; quotes shoppers saying Gucci bags lose half their value the moment you leave the store.

items.title: "할머니 집 같아" 탄식…구찌 매장 '폐쇄 선언' 초유의 사태
items.summary: Coverage of Kering's ReconKering restructuring: Gucci to close roughly 125 stores by 2030 (half of Kering's planned 250 closures), after Q1 2026 sales fell 8% YoY; CEO Luca De Meo is quoted saying some Gucci stores "look like they belong to a grandmother's house," a rare direct executive critique of store presentation quality.

items.title: Gucci names aespa's Ningning as global ambassador
items.summary: Gucci appointed aespa member Ningning as a global brand ambassador, part of the house's continued K-pop-led strategy to drive engagement in Korea and China; announcement generated significant fan-account amplification across Korean and Chinese social platforms.

items.source: starnewskorea / Daum entertainment wire — 닝닝 구찌 앰버서더
items.title: '물오른 미모' 에스파 닝닝, '구찌' 글로벌 브랜드 앰버서더 됐다
items.summary: Korean entertainment-desk report on Ningning's Gucci ambassador appointment; largely descriptive activation coverage (quotes Ningning saying she is "honored" and has admired the brand since childhood) with no independent critical evaluation — treated as brand-owned promo copy under the activation-coverage discount.

items.source: WWD Japan — デムナのグッチ採点
items.title: 賛否両論のデムナの「グッチ」は10点満点中の何点？ 業界アナリストが辛口リポート
items.summary: WWD Japan trade-press analyst scorecard on Demna's debut Gucci collection is split: jackets and trousers scored well but shoes and handbags were called dull, and the overall look was described by some as lacking elegance rather than being sexy, even as many buyers said Demna's vision resonates with Gucci's identity.

items.title: [단독] 구찌, 연말 가격 또 올렸다…마몽 미니백 9.5% '조용히' 인상
items.summary: Investigative report that Gucci quietly raised Korean retail prices without notice in late October, with the Marmont mini shoulder bag rising 9.5% (2.22m to 2.43m KRW) and Ophidia small tote among other items also increased; framed within a broader pattern of unannounced repeated luxury price hikes drawing "Korea-only price gouging" criticism. Included for competitor-price-hike-backlash context though outside the 14-day window; retained as background trend, not counted as fresh signal.

items.title: 명품 갤러리 — 구찌 정품/레플리카 판별 문의 스레드
items.summary: Korean luxury-goods community board (DCInside 명품 갤러리) hosts recurring threads where users ask others to verify whether Gucci wallets/bags purchased are authentic versus replica; reflects lingering consumer distrust/counterfeit-adjacent anxiety around Gucci goods rather than organic praise or criticism of the brand's design direction. Treated per rubric as neutral-to-mild-negative (counterfeit inquiries).

items.source: 知乎 (Zhihu) — Gucci vs Coach quality discussion
items.title: 蔻驰比古驰相比，哪个更好？
items.summary: Ongoing Zhihu Q&A thread comparing Coach and Gucci; recent answers cited in aggregator commentary note Gucci's brand over-extension into everyday goods (shoes, socks, fragrance) as diluting luxury positioning, and mention QC complaints (scratches, poor after-sales) reported by some Tmall flagship-store buyers.

items.source: 抖音 (Douyin) search — 古驰手提袋 quality complaints
items.title: 古驰手提袋哪里容易烂 (where Gucci handbags wear out easily) — Douyin search trend
items.summary: Active Douyin search/content cluster of user videos discussing where Gucci handbags tend to show wear or damage first, indicating organic consumer-generated quality-complaint content circulating on the platform; individual video engagement counts not visible via search-result view.

items.source: Elle China — 古驰七夕短片
items.title: 古驰七夕短片：爱意相扣的瞬间
items.summary: Descriptive coverage of a Gucci Qixi (Chinese Valentine's Day) short-film campaign; purely activation write-up (what it is, format, release) with no independent evaluative verdict from the outlet, so scored 0 under the activation-coverage discount rather than counted as organic positive sentiment.

items.title: "파격·실험의 구찌로 돌아왔다"…뎀나가 이끈 2026 프리폴 컬렉션 룩북 공개
items.summary: Vogue Korea's review of Demna's Pre-Fall 2026 Gucci lookbook gives an independent evaluative verdict, praising the squishy bags, soft loafers, slouchy jeans and Tom Ford-era-reminiscent tailoring as strong; qualifies for full positive magnitude under the rubric as third-party critical judgment rather than press-kit description, though it is outside the 14-day freshness window (retained as trend context only).

items.source: Michelin Guide Japan — Gucci Osteria Tokyo
items.title: Gucci Osteria Tokyo Receives First Michelin Star
items.summary: Gucci's Ginza-flagship Osteria da Massimo Bottura restaurant retained/received a Michelin star in the 2026 Japan guide; positive third-party culinary recognition, though a lifestyle-extension story rather than core fashion-business signal and outside the fresh window (background context only).
